name: tencent-cos-upload
description: Upload, download, delete and safely rename individual Tencent COS objects.

interface.shortDescription: Upload, download, delete and rename COS objects.
interface.longDescription: Four independent MCP tools: video upload, object download, confirmed exact-object deletion and guarded copy-verify-delete rename. No cutting, transcoding, generation, recursive deletion or bucket administration. Credentials stay in environment variables; signed URLs are the default.
defaultPrompt: Upload the video I specify to Tencent COS and return a temporary signed URL.
Download the exact COS object I specify to a new local file.
Preview the exact COS object deletion or rename before confirmation.
